project_comments.note: StringParameter::getValue() (lines 143-151) calls parent::getValue() twice when the value is a string — once for the type check and once as the return value. Pre-existing, outside WP-001 scope. Future cleanup: store parent::getValue() in a local variable and return it directly, eliminating the redundant call.

Cross-cutting observation: Both WPs completed at revision 0 with no rework cycles — a sign of well-scoped plan and clean handoffs. The key architectural decision to read $_REQUEST directly in ClearableStringParameter::resolveValue() (rather than modifying the shared RequestParam::get() path) successfully isolated the change to a single new class. The WP-001 → WP-002 dependency was correctly sequenced: MaxLengthValidation's skip-guard for empty strings made setMaxLength() compose naturally with ClearableStringParameter without any special casing. Future validator additions should verify this composition property against clearable parameters at design time.
